subject: Altline HoldCo: billing destination, VAT registration & collection plan
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@altline.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@altline.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Altline HoldCo — billing remittance + VAT documentation

Hi Nikhil,

Hope you’re well. Quick heads-up: Altline was acquired by Altline HoldCo (closing 2028-02-01) and finance has consolidated payment operations under the new legal entity. We need Redwood to route future invoices to the HoldCo billing address and update tax/VAT handling for our EU subsidiary.

Please update the remit and invoice header to:
Altline HoldCo, Inc.
Accounts Payable
980 Market St, Suite 1400
San Francisco, CA 94102
EIN: 94-1234567

For EU VAT: our Luxembourg subsidiary (Altline EU S.à r.l.) provided the VAT certificate — attached (Altline_VAT-Cert_EU.pdf). We’d like to confirm whether Redwood will:
- Issue net invoices to Altline EU (reverse-charge) when applicable, or
- Continue gross invoices and have Altline handle VAT on our side.

Also attaching a current W-9 for HoldCo (Altline_W-9_2028.pdf) and a draft PO for Feb (PO-AL-202802). Could you confirm:
1) Who at Redwood should receive the updated remit info and sign-off on reissuing Jan/Feb invoices?
2) Whether Redwood needs any additional tax residency docs?
3) If there’s a reissue fee or process to rerun previously paid invoices under the new bill-to?

Happy to hop on a short call this week if that helps — Elena/Procurement team are available Wed/Thu mornings PST.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement — Altline AI
elena.ruiz@altline.ai
+1 415-555-2187

Attachments: Altline_W-9_2028.pdf (pdf), Altline_VAT-Cert_EU.pdf (pdf), PO-AL-202802.pdf (pdf)
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@altline.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, procurement@altline.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Altline HoldCo — billing remittance + VAT documentation

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and congrats on closing. I’ve shared the remit details with our billing team and looped in Monica (Finance Ops) to own the reissue and VAT handling. A few quick asks so we can process cleanly: 

- Confirm PO: is PO-AL-202802 the only PO we should apply for invoices issued in Feb, or will there be a separate blanket PO for Q2?
- Reissue scope: do you need Jan 2028 reissued or just Feb onward? Reissuing issued-and-paid invoices requires finance approval — Monica, can you outline the cutover process?
- Bank details: if payments are moving to the HoldCo treasury, please confirm if the bank account on the PO is the final account we should mark as remit-to. If different, we’ll need a bank confirmation letter (recommended).

Tentative next steps from our side:
1) Monica will verify attachments and confirm whether a reissue fee applies and estimated timeline (2–5 business days typical).
2) If EU reverse-charge applies, Marcus (tax counsel) may ask for VAT registration numbers and the relevant contract clause to ensure correct tax treatment.
3) Once Monica confirms, we’ll reissue invoices and update your billing contact in our AR system.

If Wed morning PST works, I can set a 20-minute slot with Monica and your procurement lead to finalize.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Manager — Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0123
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@altline.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@altline.ai>, procurement@altline.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Altline HoldCo — billing remittance + VAT documentation

Thanks Nikhil — quick clarifications:
- PO-AL-202802 covers Feb invoices only; finance will issue a Q2 blanket PO by 2028-03-05. Please proceed with reissuing Feb.
- Jan: please do not reissue Jan unless Redwood requires it for your internal reconciliation — we can handle the Jan variance from our side.
- Bank: the HoldCo treasury account is listed on PO-AL-202802 and is final. We attached the bank confirmation page in the PO PDF.

Regarding VAT: Altline EU is VAT-registered (VAT LU21456789). We prefer reverse-charge (net invoices) where allowed. If Redwood needs contract confirmation, we can provide the resale/service annex referencing intra-group supply — happy to have Marcus confirm specifics with your tax team.

Wed 9:30am PST works for a 20-min sync.

— Elena
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, michael_grant@redwood.com, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@altline.ai>, procurement@altline.ai
Date: Thu, 23 Feb 2028 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Altline HoldCo — billing remittance + VAT documentation

Folks — forwarding Altline’s docs for tax/legal review and to confirm internal steps. Key points / asks:

- They want Feb invoices reissued to Altline HoldCo remit-to and net treatment for EU where allowed.
- Attachments: Altline_W-9_2028.pdf, Altline_VAT-Cert_EU.pdf, invoice_202802-A_altline.pdf (sample).

Action items:
1) Marcus — please confirm whether reverse-charge is supported for the listed services (cloud inference / API access) and whether we require a contract amendment or a customer-signed tax representation form. ETA: EOD Fri if possible.
2) Michael — if we reissue Feb invoices, please confirm whether any accounting code adjustments or memo lines are required to preserve revenue recognition and let us know if reissue will affect our monthly AR close. If there is a small reissue fee or journal entry, note amount.
3) Nikhil — schedule the 20-min sync Wed 9:30am PST and include Altline procurement + Marcus.

If we can get Marcus’s quick confirmation, we’ll reply to Elena with a plan and timeline.

Thanks — Monica
